title.en: Doing good is part of good character

recall.uz: «Axloq» rivoyatini tinglab oʻqiymiz va yaxshi axloqning qadri haqida bilib olamiz.
recall.ru: Слушаем предание «Нрав» и узнаём о ценности доброго нрава.
recall.en: We read the legend “Character” and learn the worth of good character.

props.title: Axloq
lines: Suv, Olov va Axloq — uchovi doʻst boʻlishibdi.
«Agar yoʻqolib qolsang, seni qayerdan topamiz?» — deyishibdi.

prompt.ru: Послушай и читай, следя за текстом!
prompt.en: Listen and follow along as you read!

hint.en: Can lost character be found again?

explanation.uz: Rivoyat yaxshi axloqni bir marta yoʻqotsang, qaytarish qiyinligi haqida.
explanation.ru: Предание о том, что утраченный нрав трудно вернуть.
explanation.en: The legend shows that lost good character is hard to regain.

text.en: If you hear splashing, that's where I am.
If you see smoke, that's where I am.

text.ru: Потеряете меня — не ищите, не найдёте.
text.en: If you lose me, don't search — you won't find me.

clue.uz: Bu gap Suv, Olov yoki Axloqniki?
clue.ru: Чьи это слова — Воды, Огня или Нрава?
clue.en: Whose line — Water, Fire or Character?

hint.uz: Har biri oʻzini qayerdan topishni aytadi.
hint.en: Each says where it can be found.

explanation.uz: Suv — sharillash; Olov — tutun; Axloq — yoʻqolsa topilmaydi.
explanation.ru: Вода — журчание; Огонь — дым; Нрав — не найти.
explanation.en: Water — splashing; Fire — smoke; Character — cannot be found.

statement.uz: Yaxshi axloqni bir marta yoʻqotsang, uni qayta topish qiyin.
statement.en: Once good character is lost, it is hard to regain.

why.en: Character says: “if you lose me, you won't find me.”

explanation.en: True: lost character is hard to regain.

clue.en: Build the 3 words — the legend's characters

prompt.en: Build the legend's characters from the letters!

explanation.uz: Harflardan suv, olov, axloq soʻzlari chiqadi.
explanation.ru: Из букв выходят suv, olov, axloq.
explanation.en: The letters make suv, olov, axloq.

statement.en: Water can be found by its splashing sound.

why.uz: Suv: «sharillagan ovozni eshitsangiz, men oʻshandaman», — deydi.
why.en: Water says: “if you hear splashing, I'm there.”

hint.en: How did Water say to find it?

explanation.en: True: water is found by its splashing.

prompt.en: Match each word to its meaning!

explanation.uz: xavotirlanmoq = tashvishlanmoq; axloq = xulq; sayr = aylanish.
explanation.ru: xavotirlanmoq = тревожиться; axloq = нрав; sayr = прогулка.
explanation.en: xavotirlanmoq = to worry; axloq = character; sayr = a walk.

choices.uz: Yaxshi axloqni bir marta yoʻqotsang, qaytarish qiyin
choices.en: Lost good character is hard to regain
Character is easy to get back

prompt.en: What conclusion follows from Character's words?

hint.en: “If you lose me, you won't find me” — what does it mean?

explanation.uz: Yaxshi axloqni asrash kerak — bir marta yoʻqotsang, qaytarish qiyin.
explanation.ru: Добрый нрав надо беречь — вернуть его трудно.
explanation.en: Guard good character — once lost, it is hard to regain.

openEnd.uz: Yaxshi axloqni saqlash uchun nima qilish kerak deb oʻylaysan?
openEnd.ru: Что нужно, чтобы сохранить добрый нрав, как думаешь?
openEnd.en: What is needed to keep good character, do you think?

prompt.en: Tap the signs of good character!

hint.ru: Добрый нрав — это добро к другим.
hint.en: Good character means kindness to others.

explanation.uz: Mehribonlik, halollik, yordam — yaxshi axloq; yolgʻon, qoʻpollik — yoʻq.
explanation.ru: Доброта, честность, помощь — добрый нрав; ложь, грубость — нет.
explanation.en: Kindness, honesty, helping are good character; lying, rudeness are not.

prompt.en: Complete the sentence with the right word!

hint.uz: Suv va olovni topsa boʻladi, buni esa yoʻq.
hint.ru: Воду и огонь можно найти, а это — нет.
hint.en: Water and fire can be found; this one cannot.

explanation.en: Lost good character is hard to regain.

meaning.en: Character — a person's conduct and manners.

prompt.uz: Harflarni toʻgʻri ketma-ketlikda bosib, soʻzni oʻqing!
prompt.ru: Нажимай буквы по порядку и прочитай слово!
prompt.en: Tap the letters in the right order to read the word!

hint.en: The legend's third friend starts with “a”.
